rules.statement: Lease bonds for a 2/3 share of co-owned land can be valid even if executed pending a partition action, provided they were executed after the court directed registration of a fresh lis pendens.
rules.supporting_quote: In the circumstances the said bonds are valid for the purpose of consideration of the issue of a licence to mine for gems.

meta.parties: Dingiri Mahatmaya and Others v. Samaraweera and Others
